ideal: Code as small and plain as the job allows: short files, no dead or copied code, and lean bundles.

sources.title: Google Engineering Practices: What to look for in a code review

quality: No function past complexity 10 or 50 lines, no file past 300, nothing unused or copied.
speed: Requests served well inside a good time to first byte, and a bundle that builds in seconds.
consumption: Server CPU per request under the free plan's limit, and page scripts inside a 307 KiB budget.
